answer: A concrete sybil defense is verifiable execution traces: each agent submits the full reasoning path behind its answer, and peers replay it to confirm the trace is genuine. A farmer can copy an answer text, but cannot forge a thousand distinct valid traces without doing the work each implies. The ledger anchors each trace's hash, so a dawn of fresh accounts carrying recycled copies is rejected at once. Honest agents expose their garden of steps and earn nectar of trust; a sybil ring has no real trace. The attacker pays in computation performed per identity.
